notes.title: Hotfix 1.4
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone helping us improve Broventure: The Wild Co-op today! We’ve just rolled out a hotfix addressing several issues and making the experience even smoother.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Stars:[/b] a bug that caused stars for completing levels to display incorrectly has been fixed.
[*] [b]Achievements:[/b] progress tracking issues have been fixed.
[*] [b]Crash:[/b] an issue where a player leaving with companions or a protective bubble caused the host to crash has been resolved.
[*] [b]Boss projectiles:[/b] the projectiles now break against rocks.
[*] [b]Hitboxes:[/b] hero hitboxes have been adjusted; now a hero will not receive any damage without contact with the enemy or their projectiles.
[*] [b]Bows:[/b] projectile speed has been adjusted for more accurate hits.
[*] [b]Camera:[/b] more space is now visible at the bottom of the screen.
[*] [b]Dash:[/b] the dash path now indicates a more precise endpoint.
[/list]
[b]Optimization:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Cards:[/b] the animation of cards has been optimized.
[/list]
Thanks for playing and reporting feedback. More updates to come!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone jumping into Broventure: The Wild Co-op today! We’ve just rolled out a hotfix addressing several issues and making the experience even smoother.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] "Dancer" Achievement: Fixed an issue where the achievement was not being displayed in the game.
[*] Quests (Chapter 5): Fixed a bug that caused quests not to be counted. They now function correctly.
[*] Companion behavior during the final boss fight: Previously, dragons and golems did not attack the meteorite. Companions now correctly deal damage to the meteorite.
[*] Crash after defeating the final boss: Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash under certain conditions after defeating the final boss.
[/list]
[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased drop from the final boss: The reward for defeating the final boss is now more generous.
[/list]
Thanks for playing and reporting feedback so quickly. More updates to come!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone jumping into Broventure: The Wild Co-op today! We’ve just rolled out a small hotfix addressing several early issues and making the experience even smoother.

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed various visual effects and elements
[*] Improved user interface clarity and responsiveness
[*] General bug fixes and stability improvements
[*] Performance optimizations across all systems
[*] Adjusted gameplay balance in several areas
[*] Fixed issues related to quest progression and completion
[*] Increased number of visible lobbies to improve matchmaking and search

notes.title: Broventure: The Wild Co-op — Full Release is Here!
notes.notes:
We’re beyond excited to finally say it: Broventure: The Wild Co-op is out now!

It’s been a long journey for us as a team — from concept to full release — and we couldn’t have done it without your encouragement, support, and feedback along the way. Thank you for sticking with us!

Now let’s dive into what’s waiting for you in the full version of the game:

[b]New Biomes[/b]:
[list]
[*] Forest
[*] Desert
[*] Volcano
[*] Runic Forest
[*] Swamp
[*] Final Boss Arena
[/list]
[b]New Heroes[/b]:
[list]
[*] Hamster
[*] Cat
[*] Deer
[*] Crocodile
[/list]
[b]Tons of New Gear and Abilities[/b]:
[list]
[*] Discover powerful new sets and playstyles as you explore deeper into the wilds.
[/list]
[b]New Original Music Tracks[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fresh tracks have been added throughout the game, enhancing the atmosphere and making every adventure feel alive.
[/list]
[b]Major Fixes & Improvements[/b]:
[list]
[*] Effects polishing and visual refinements
[*] Interface and HUD improvements
[*] General bug fixes and corrections
[*] Game optimization for smoother performance
[*] Balance adjustments to improve gameplay pacing
[*] Epilepsy and content warning messages added
[*] All lobby members can now interact with hub buildings — not just the host
[/list]
This release marks a huge milestone for us, but it’s only the beginning. We can’t wait to hear what you think and to see all your co-op adventures out in the wilds.

From all of us at Alice Games — thank you, and happy adventuring!

notes.title: Broventure: The Wild Co-op Launches Today at 13:00 UTC!
notes.notes:
The wait is almost over — Broventure: The Wild Co-op officially launches today at 13:00 UTC on Steam!

Thank you all for your incredible support during the demo period and development journey. We’re so excited for you to experience the full version of the game, with new biomes, heroes, music, and tons of improvements.

We'll be around for the launch and eager to hear your thoughts, see your co-op crews, and read your feedback.

See you in the wild! 🌿

notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to officially announce that Broventure: The Wild Co-op is launching on May 15, 2025!
Gather your crew, sharpen your blades, and get ready for a chaotic co-op journey into a vibrant and dangerous world.

In the full version of Broventure, you’ll find a ton of new content waiting for you:

✅ [b]A brand new map[/b]: Explore fresh biomes filled with secrets, dangers, and rewards.
✅ [b]New enemies[/b]: Tougher, weirder, and wilder than ever. Fight for survival against corrupted wildlife, mutated guardians, and more.
✅ [b]New abilities[/b]: Discover powerful upgrades and perks to customize your playstyle and support your team in combat.
✅ [b]Expanded base content[/b]: Build and unlock more than ever before, upgrading your home base to access new characters and gear.

Whether you're jumping in solo or teaming up with friends, Broventure: The Wild Co-op is packed with action, progression, and exploration.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2939640/Broventure_The_Wild_Coop/

Check out the brand-new trailer and get hyped for what’s coming!

notes.title: Broventure Update 0.9.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers! This update brings important stability improvements, balance tweaks, and new features to enhance your experience. We’ve been listening to your feedback and working hard to make Broventure even better. Here’s what’s new:

[b]Version Stability & Bug Fixes[/b]:
• Fixed various crashes and freezes to improve overall game stability.
• Resolved multiple bugs affecting gameplay performance.

[b]Balance Adjustments[/b]:
• Buffed melee weapons for a more satisfying and powerful combat experience.

[b]New Features & Improvements[/b]:
• Added new visual effects to enhance the game’s atmosphere.
• Optimized game settings for better performance across different setups.
• Introduced adjustable camera distance setting s— zoom in or out to find the perfect view!

We’d love to hear your thoughts! Join our Discord to chat with the community, share your feedback, and report any bugs. See you in the wilds!

🔗 [url=https://discord.gg/QCKqYk3FZr]Join our Discord[/url]

notes.title: Broventure on Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that Broventure is part of this year’s Steam Next Fest, and the demo is officially available for you to play! 

Steam Next Fest is all about celebrating indie games and giving you a chance to experience upcoming titles — Broventure is no exception! Jump into this co-op action-adventure, where you and your friends can explore vibrant environments, craft gear, unlock characters, and take on the challenge of saving nature together.

Whether you’re a fan of survival, crafting, or just love a good co-op adventure, Broventure has something for everyone! 

Play the demo today, give us your feedback, and let’s make this adventure even better together!

notes.title: Broventure Demo Now Ready on Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
We’ve come a long way, and we couldn’t be more excited to finally share that the Broventure demo is now live on Steam Deck! From the very beginning, your support has been incredible – whether you’ve been testing, providing feedback, or just cheering us on, it’s been an amazing journey to get to this point. Our community is at the heart of everything we do, and it’s your enthusiasm that keeps pushing us forward. 🙏💥

Now, you can take Broventure with you wherever you go! We’ve made sure the Steam Deck experience is just as smooth as playing on PC, so whether you're hanging out at home or out exploring, your adventure continues uninterrupted.

[b]Here’s what you can expect[/b]:
✅ Seamless Steam Deck performance – Play anytime, anywhere, with no performance hiccups!
✅ Perfect controller support – Optimized for the Deck’s controls, ensuring a smooth and intuitive experience.
✅ Co-op gameplay – Team up and save nature, even while on the go!
✅ Smooth, stable performance – Enjoy a consistent and lag-free experience no matter where you are.
✅ Controller support – Fully optimized for the Steam Deck’s controller layout.
✅ Correct button prompts – All controls are clearly mapped for a user-friendly experience.
✅ Steam Deck resolution support – Beautiful visuals that match the Deck’s native resolution.
✅ Stable framerate at default graphics settings – Enjoy smooth and consistent gameplay.
✅ Clear in-game text – Legible and easy to read, even on the Deck’s smaller screen.
✅ Cloud save synchronization – Seamlessly sync your progress between PC and Steam Deck.
✅ Native Proton / Linux support – Enjoy full compatibility with Linux-based systems.
✅ Excellent overall gaming experience – Optimized for the Steam Deck, delivering an exceptional gaming experience on the device.

We couldn’t have made it this far without the support of our amazing community. If you have any thoughts or run into anything while playing the demo on Steam Deck, we’re all ears! You can always reach us on Steam or hop into our Discord – we’re here and always ready to help.

Thanks again for all the love, and enjoy the demo!

notes.title: Last Chance to Playtest Broventure!

Our open playtest is coming to an end! Tomorrow will be your final chance to jump in, test the game, and share your feedback before we close the servers.

But don’t worry — we’re preparing a brand-new demo that will be available soon! Plus, we’re gearing up for Steam Next Fest on February 24, where we’ll showcase Broventure with exciting updates.

Stay tuned, and thank you to everyone who joined the playtest! 💪🔥

notes.title: Update 0.9.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We’re rolling out a big update packed with improvements, new features, and fixes! Here’s what’s new:

[b]New Features[/b]
• Training Camp: Upgrade passive abilities and strengthen your character between battles.
• Weapon Evolution: Combine weapons to unlock powerful late-game versions for ultimate destruction.
• Steam Integration: Player nicknames now sync directly from Steam.

[b]Improvements[/b]
• Enhanced visual effects for abilities and gameplay.
• Balanced sound and music volumes for a better audio experience.
• Simplified final boss mechanics for smoother progression.
• Revamped quest system to make finding objectives easier.
• Better loot scattering and pickup mechanics.
• Improved multiplayer functionality for the Meteorite Shard—now benefits the entire team!

[b]Fixes[/b]
• Resolved crash issues at the end of matches.
• Fixed numerous bugs for a smoother experience.
• Polished in-game text and UI.

[b]Important Note[/b]
This update introduces new functionality that might cause issues with older save files. To enjoy the best experience, we highly recommend starting fresh with a new save.

notes.title: Broventure Update: Multiplayer & New Features
notes.notes:
We’ve been working hard to make Broventure: The Wild Co-op better than ever. Check out what’s new in our latest update!

[b]Improvements:[/b]
• Smoother interfaces: Enhanced responsiveness and polished animations.
• Game text refinements: Improved clarity and quality of in-game text.
• Balance tuning: Gameplay is now better balanced for an improved experience.
• Upgraded UI and icons: More intuitive and visually appealing designs.
• Increased stability: Fewer crashes and a smoother experience.
• Smarter companions: AI improvements for better teamwork.

[b]New Features:[/b]
• Multiplayer mode: Play with 2, 3, or 4 players for maximum fun!
• New cooperative abilities: Discover unique powers to share with your team.
• Healing mechanics: Fresh ways to recover and strategize in battle.
• Russian localization: The game is now fully translated into Russian.
• Updated effects: Fresh ability visuals for a more immersive experience.
• Crossbow mechanics: Revamped for more satisfying gameplay.
• Boss behavior: Smarter and more challenging mini-bosses and bosses.
• Enhanced effects: Tons of new visuals and particle effects in-game.
• New sounds & music: Level up your immersion with fresh tracks and soundscapes.
• Level-up knockback & bubble destruction: New mechanics to spice up the action.

We can’t wait for you to try these updates and hear what you think! Jump in, explore the changes, and let us know your feedback in the community.

notes.title: Broventure Open Playtest - Steam Bullet Heaven Festival
notes.notes:
We’re beyond excited to announce that Broventure: The Wild Co-op is officially participating in the Steam Bullet Heaven Festival! This marks a major milestone for our game, and we couldn’t have made it here without the support and enthusiasm of players like you.

For the first time, we’re opening our doors wide with an open playtest—giving you a chance to explore the world of Broventure and experience its chaotic, action-packed gameplay firsthand.

This isn’t just a game; it’s a journey we want to take together. Your feedback during this playtest will be pivotal in shaping Broventure. Whether you’re tackling the challenges solo or teaming up with friends, we want to hear it all—your thoughts, suggestions, and even those unexpected laughs or frustrations that come along the way.

[b]What You Can Expect:
[/b]
• High-octane co-op action: Grab a buddy or go solo as you navigate thrilling levels.
• Wild, unpredictable challenges: Master bullet-dodging and tactical gameplay in a vibrant world.
• A growing community: Be part of the foundation of Broventure and help us make it the best it can be.

This playtest isn’t just a showcase; it’s a dialogue. We’re here, ready to listen and learn from you. Your voice matters, and together, we’ll make Broventure a truly unforgettable experience.

Join our Discord to share your game experience: https://discord.gg/hXvewGYV

The festival is only here for a limited time, so don’t miss your chance to join in and help shape the adventure. See you in-game!
